scope: Native i386 VMX source interfaces and status-preserving VMXOFF across LLVM, NeverC and NeverD

baseline_proof.post_audit_delta: None; reran the exact source-only audit on the integrated source.

limits: Controlled instruction completions validate compiler transport, not a hardware VMCS or successful VM entry.
VMLAUNCH and VMRESUME only test falling-through VMfail completions.
Complete generated i386 C uses flat segment bases; separate address witnesses check nonzero segment bases and 16-bit truncation.
Native fault witnesses execute x86-64 CPL3 only; i386 fault boundaries are controlled.
Windows/Darwin i386 source targets and physical-address i386 SVM source APIs remain separate gaps.
Original-machine real/VM86/IA-32e transfers, task switching, other i386 banks, software SMM/SGX and unbound asynchronous producers remain open.
No global x86 completion or final LLVM release claim.
